title.rendered: How to fix ‘An SSL Error Has Occurred’ in Apple Music

content.rendered:
Being a music lover, I understand the importance of uninterrupted access to our favorite tunes. And nothing can be more frustrating than encountering technical hurdles in this experience. If you are bothered by an SSL error in Apple Music on your iPhone, then don’t worry. I have got your back.

Jump on this ride to fix the dreaded “An SSL error has occurred” message in Apple Music and get your streaming back on track!

What is an SSL error in Apple Music?

A Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) error in Apple Music is a very scarce warning, known to signify that the server certificate cannot be verified by the client. A user is prompted by this error only when the connection between the client device and Apple Music servers fails to meet the required security protocols designed to protect the data exchanged during communication.

At its core, Apple Music uses SSL encryption for transmitting user data over the internet. The main role of this codec is to provide an extra layer of security and ensure that volatile credentials such as usernames, passwords, and card details remain hidden from potential attackers or cyber threats.

When an SSL error occurs in Apple Music, users may be unable to access certain features or complete transactions safely. As a result, it is absolutely vital that you take necessary precautions to steer clear of errors like these.

7 Solutions to fix SSL error in Apple Music on iPhone

Without any further ado, let’s get on with the solutions to get Apple Music back on track!

1. Check your network connection

If Apple Music appears to be unstable and displays the SSL error, it might be because of the poor network connection of your device. There is a high chance that weak internet is preventing an effective data transmission between Apple servers and your device.

So, ensure you have a stable and active internet connection. You can try connecting to a different Wi-Fi network or switching to a cellular network to rule out any network-related issues.

Alternatively, you can resolve this issue by clearing out the DNS cache on your device. If this doesn’t work, try disabling on-guard VPNs or third-party browser extensions that can possibly interfere with your internet connection.

2. Check the System Status of Apple Music

If you’re experiencing an SSL error in Apple Music, it’s viable to hover through the system status of the app. You can rectify this by following a simple and straightforward method.

On the Apple System Status page:

  • Green dot suggests that Apple Music is functioning effectively.
  • Red Triangle suggests a service outage.
  • Yellow Rhombus indicates an issue with the service.

In case Apple Music mentions a system outage or an ongoing aid to the service, then you can do nothing but wait till the service is back up. However, if there aren’t any factors affecting Apple Music, you can proceed with the methods prescribed below.

3. Check the Date & Time of your region

Incorrect date and time can cause SSL errors in Apple Music. Users often encounter this problem whenever the server fails to verify the security certificate required for accessing applications securely.

  1. Open the Settings app on your iPhone → Go to General.
  2. Select Date & Time.
  3. Now, toggle on Set Automatically.

This process will automatically align your device with your existing region and allow your device to communicate securely with the Apple Music server. As a result, every encountered SSL error will be resolved in a jiffy.

4. Restart your iPhone

One potential solution to fix the “SSL error has occurred” prompt in Apple Music is to restart the device effective immediately. This can help refresh the connection link between your device and the Apple server, which might have been disrupted due to various unknown factors.

Regardless of the iPhone you use, there is a sure-shot way to restart your device on the go. Once your device is successfully back-up again, access Apple Music and verify if the SSL error was fixed or not. However, if the problem still persists, don’t frown, as there are a few additional solutions for troubleshooting Apple Music errors on your iPhone.

5. Reinstall Apple Music

The SSL errors occur only when the digital certificate fails to verify the authenticity of an application from Apple’s servers. Nevertheless, if you do not prefer to get lost in the wilderness of technicalities, then removing the application and reinstalling the same from scratch can be a viable approach.

To uninstall the app:

  1. Long-press Apple Music on the Home Screen.
  2. Select Remove App → Select Delete App to confirm.

Now, reinstall the Music app from App Store so that you can get through the SSL bug interfering with the app’s performance.

Attempt to access your account or the playback feature upon reinstalling Apple Music, and you should be good to go.

6. Update iOS to the latest stable version

The latest iOS 17 update has got Apple fanatics on their toes. But, as of writing, only the Developer Beta is out, and it has a ton of bugs and errors to be dealt with. This can be a prominent factor in affecting Apple Music with the SSL error. Well, not anymore.

If you’re tired of using a buggy and broken iOS version, it may be a good time to recall the latest stable iOS 16 update to your iPhone.

The SSL error usually occurs when there is a problem with the security certificate used by Apple Music, and updating your iOS to stable firmware can resolve this problem.

7. Contact Apple Support

If none of these fixes could solve your problem, consider reaching out to Apple’s customer support for more technical assistance. Be prepared to provide detailed information about when you first noticed this error, along with any specific blunder codes or messages that may have appeared.

Why is my Apple Music saying SSL?

The ‘An SSL Error Has Occurred’ message in Apple Music indicates an issue with the SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) certificate, which is responsible for securing the connection between your device and the Apple Music servers. This error can prevent you from streaming music.

Will fixing the SSL error cause any data loss or affect my Apple Music library?

No, fixing the SSL error should not cause any data loss or impact on your Apple Music library. The steps provided are primarily focused on resolving the SSL certificate issue and ensuring a smooth streaming experience.

Is an SSL error a common problem in Apple Music?

While SSL errors are not extremely common in Apple Music, they can occur due to various factors. It’s essential to stay updated with the latest app version and maintain a stable internet connection to minimize the chances of encountering such errors.

Groove to the beats!

Conclusively, fixing an SSL error requires a bit of patience and troubleshooting on the user’s end. However, these steps should be able to resolve the issue without any hassle and get your Apple Music up and running. Now you can enjoy your favorite music without being bothered by interruptions. Remember, tech can be unpredictable at times, but armed with the right knowledge, you can overcome any hurdle blocking your way.

Thank you for reading. Please leave your thoughts in the comments below.

About Suraj Padmasali

  • Suraj oversees daily publishing on iGeeksBlog.com as the operations head at iGeeks Media.
  • Suraj has over 10 years of experience in implementing SEO and social media campaigns with an emphasis on brand integration.
  • He developed an editorial quality management program for iGeeks Media, which is an ongoing effort to continuously optimize static content and create the best possible reader experience.

Experience

Suraj began his career in SEO. Due to his immense fascination with Apple products and his keen interest in the iPhone, he started writing and editing content for iGeeksBlog. Currently, he is responsible for overseeing the production of content and maintaining editorial quality for iGeeksBlog. He has established strong connections to obtain the latest news and updates from the tech world.

title.rendered: How to use Zoom on Apple Watch

content.rendered:
You would like to use Zoom on your Apple Watch in order to read emails or notifications conveniently. The tiny screen size of the watch tends to make it slightly difficult to scan through contents on the watch. That’s when a quality feature like Zoom can come to your rescue. It’s very simple to set up and use Zoom on Apple Watch. In fact, the process of activating it on the Watch is quite identical to iPhone’s.

How to enable Zoom from Apple Watch 

  1. Press Digital Crown. 
  2. Head to Settings → Accessibility → Tap Zoom. 

     
  3. Toggle on Zoom. 

Note: Adjust the zooming by tapping the plus or minus button on the Maximum Zoom Level.

Don’t you want to use the zoom on your watch anymore? You can quickly turn it off, just toggle the switch next to Zoom on your Apple Watch.

How to turn on Zoom from iPhone

  1. Launch the Watch app on your iPhone.  
  2. Tap My Watch tab. 
  3. Go to Accessibility → Zoom. 
  4. Toggle on Zoom. 
    You can limit the max zoom by dragging the Maximum Zoom Level slider.

Adjust hand gestures for Zoom 

  1. Go to Watch app → My Watch. 
  2. Tap Accessibility → Zoom → Hand Gestures. 
  3. Toggle on Hand Gestures. 
  4. Choose any option below Customize Gestures. I’m choosing Double Clench. 
    • Clench 
    • Double Clench 
    • Tap 
    • Double Tap
  5. Select Toggle Zoom. You can also choose Pan Forward, Pan Backward, or None.

Moreover, to get the Visual Signal feature, you can also activate the Activation Gesture.
Tap on Activation Gesture → choose one from Double Clench or Double Tap → toggle on Visual Signal. 

Use Zoom on Apple Watch via Accessibility shortcut to

  1. Launch the Watch app → Accessibility. 
  2. Scroll down and tap Accessibility Shortcut. 
  3. Select Zoom. 

You’ve now created the shortcut to open Zoom. To enable/disable the shortcut function, press the Digital Crown three times.

How to control Zoom on Apple Watch 

Now that you have enabled Zoom on your Apple Watch, scroll down to learn about controlling Zoom on your Apple Watch. 

  • Zoom in or out: Use two fingers to double-tap the Apple Watch screen. 
  • Move around the screen: With two fingers, you can drag the screen in the direction you wish to proceed. The small Zoom button on the Apple Watch display indicates your precise location on the screen.  
  • Using Digital Crown: Use the Digital Crown to move up-down and left-right around the display. Tap the watch with two fingers to activate the feature. 
  • Modify the magnification: To adjust the magnification, double-tap the watch screen with two fingers and drag your fingers up or down to get the perfect view.  

Zooming out…

The Apple Watch’s Zoom function is a godsend for visually challenged people, but it may be an annoying feature if you are not one of them. You just need to Zoom out on your Apple Watch to get rid of that inconvenience. Comment on whether you think the Zoom option on the Apple Watch is a boon or a bane. 

Read more: 

  • How to turn off Pinch to Zoom gesture on Mac
  • How to use double tap gesture on Apple Watch
  • How to use AssistiveTouch on Apple Watch

excerpt.rendered: The Apple Watch screen is small enough that magnification genuinely helps. Here is how to enable Zoom from either device, control it with the Digital Crown, and bind it to an Accessibility shortcut.

title.rendered: How to customize suggested strong passwords in Safari on iPhone

content.rendered:
Your iPhone helps you to generate strong passwords on Safari automatically and syncs with iCloud Keychain. But those may be too long with special characters and don’t always satisfy some website criteria. But you can alter them effortlessly. Let’s learn how to customize suggested strong passwords in Safari on iPhone.

  • How to customize suggested strong passwords on iPhone
  • Why should you edit suggested strong passwords in Safari?

How to customize suggested strong passwords on iPhone

Apple generates passwords using a hard-to-guess combination of letters, numerics, and special characters. But you can’t directly alter it. First, ensure you have enabled the iCloud Keychain and follow the steps below to customize the suggested passwords:

  1. Open a website’s account signup page in Safari.
  2. Tap the password section to generate a strong password.
  3. Select Other Options → Tap Edit Strong Password.
  4. Enter or remove characters → Tap Done.

You may select No Special Characters to get an alphanumeric password. Also, Choose My Own Password option allows you to type the password yourself. 

Once you sign up for the account, Safari will prompt you to save the password for this website on iCloud Keychain. 

Once you have created a strong password, you can easily view the saved password on your iPhone and iPad. Just go to Settings → Passwords to access passwords for each app or website.

Why should you edit suggested strong passwords in Safari?

Before iOS 16, Safari did not allow you to customize suggested passwords for apps and website logins. These passwords with special characters are significant in terms of security as they are long and hard to crack.

Also, thanks to the Autofill feature in Safari, you don’t need to remember them.  

However, some websites have standard password criteria. For example, it may ask to add capital letters or a specific amount of symbols. And Apple’s strong password generator can’t always meet the requirements. Additionally, many websites prohibit the use of special characters in passwords.

Therefore, manual editing of strong passwords becomes crucial. That’s why Safari enables you to alter suggested passwords or generate passwords without any special characters. Moreover, the browser may even provide passwords that are slightly simpler to write.

Get the desired security!

I hope you can quickly set your desired strong passwords in Safari on your iPhone now. Complex and unique passwords can reduce the risk of unauthorized access to your personal information and protect you from cyber threats. Also, regularly check for security recommendations on your iPhone and update your passwords.

title.rendered: Best Mac SNES Emulators for Casual and Retro Gamers

content.rendered:
Classic SNES games carried an entirely different charm. Still, even after years of their release, games like Super Mario, EarthBound, The Legend of Zelda, and others have a unique space in our hearts. Even though the gaming industry has transformed drastically in the last few decades, and today’s games are entirely different from those mentioned above, we still feel like playing some of them today. If you, too, fall into the same group of people, here’s a list of the best SNES emulators for Mac. Let’s have a look at them.

Table of Contents
  • 1. RetroArch
  • 2. OpenEmu
  • 3. Nestopia UE

1. RetroArch

The program works seamlessly with your Apple macOS High Sierra and later versions with Metal2. RetroArch is an open-source platform and uses Liberto cores to provide users with a better interface. Some of the advanced features it offers include netplay, shaders, next-frame response times, rewinding, Machine translation, blind accessibility, run ahead, and much more. Apart from its support for macOS, it also supports iOS and tvOS.

Not just the traditional SNES games, the platform also supports a range of other games launched on Game Boy, GameCube, etc.

Price: Free

Download

2. OpenEmu

The open-source multi-system game emulator is designed especially for macOS and comes with a plugin interface that supports games released on platforms like Genesis, Game Boy, and others. Setting it up is pretty easy to add and browse with a compatible gamepad. Originally launched in 2013, the platform made some significant changes in its recent upgrade, version 2.2, with added support for a downstream and much more.

It comes with features like multithreaded layback, high-end metal scaling, image processing, real-time 3D effects, and much more.

Price: Free

Download

3. Nestopia UE

Though it’s at number 5 on our list, the SNES Emulator has earned accolades for its features like netplay and texture scaling. Like the preceding Emulator on our list, Nestopia was left to die by its developers in the year 2008, when they stopped working on it. This is how Nestopia Undead Edition (Nestopia UE) came into existence. Deep inside, this is a simpler version of a RetroArch Emulator. Need to mention, simple as in the setup process.

Besides that, it doesn’t compromise on the performance aspect. Having said this, with Nestopia UE, you can expect to have a friendly interface, allowing you to run games without any delay.

Price: Free

Download

Concluding Note

Turning back to the gaming industry pages, we have had some of the most alluring games back then. The Emulators mentioned above are designed to give you the best experience using SNES-based games from the past. Let us know if you have used any of these and have the experience to share in the comment section.

title.rendered: How to mirror your iPhone screen to Android TV

content.rendered:
Whether for watching videos, working, attending classes, or video chatting, you can easily mirror iPhone screen to Android TV for a way better experience. With our TVs becoming smarter, we don’t need an HDMI adapter anymore; we can achieve the feat wirelessly.

How to mirror iPhone screen to Android TV – 4 Easy ways

iPhones make our lives convenient — you can stream, play games with friends, have a video chat, and attend lectures right from your screen. The best part is you can easily mirror your iPhone screen to an Android TV or any other compatible smart TV for a larger, grander experience. Here are all the ways to do so.

1. Mirror your iPhone screen to an AirPlay-compatible smart TV

This Apple feature lets you stream or share content from your devices to your Mac, Apple TV, or any AirPlay-compatible smart TV. If you aren’t sure if your TV supports AirPlay, here’s a list of AirPlay2-compatible TVs.

Now, to start mirroring, do the following:

  1. Ensure your iPhone, Android TV, or any AirPlay-compatible smart TV are on the same Wi-Fi network.
  2. Open Control Center → Tap Screen Mirroring.
  3. Select your TV from the list. If an AirPlay passcode appears on the TV, enter the passcode on your iPhone.

To stop screen mirroring from your iPhone to TV, just tap Stop Mirroring at the top of your screen or head to Control Center, tap Screen Mirroring, and tap Stop Mirroring.

2. Mirror your iPhone screen to Android TV using an HDMI cable

If your TV doesn’t support AirPlay, connecting wirelessly won’t be possible. Don’t worry; your next bet is connecting your device to the TV using an HDMI cable.

The only downside is that you’re physically limited with cables, so you won’t be able to take your iPhone with you. But if getting parted from your device isn’t an issue, this option is excellent. For better results, look for a high-speed HDMI cable.

Then do the following:

  1. Plug an adapter into your iPhone’s charging port. You’ll need this to connect your iPhone to the HDMI cable.
  2. Connect your adapter to the HDMI cable.
  3. Connect the HDMI cable to the Android TV.

3. Cast iPhone to Android TV using third-party apps

While newer TV models have a “works with Apple AirPlay” label, other Android TVs don’t. However, Chromecast-supported apps like Netflix and Google apps let you easily cast your iPhone screen to your Android TV regardless if your TV is AirPlay compatible. Just open the supported app and tap the Cast button, usually at the top or bottom right corner.

If you still can’t mirror your iPhone screen to your Android TV, you may want to try using third-party apps. Apps like AirDroid Cast Web or AirPlayMirror can help Apple users easily mirror their Apple device’s screens on Android TVs.

Regardless of the app, you still need to follow the same process. Download the app and ensure your iPhone and TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Ensure they’re close to the router to have the best viewing experience.

4. Stream video from your iPhone to smart TV

Aside from screencasting, you can stream videos from your iPhone to a TV. The process is similar and involves the following:

  1. Connect your iPhone to the same Wi-Fi network as your smart TV.
  2. Find the video you want to stream on your iPhone.
  3. Tap AirPlay. Some apps may have an additional step. For example, if the video is in Photos, tap Share → AirPlay.
  4. Choose your TV from the list.

To stop streaming, select AirPlay in the app and tap your iPhone from the list that will appear.

What to do if your iPhone video automatically streams to an Airplay device?

If you frequently stream on your TV with your iPhone, there’s a tendency for it to stream a video from your iPhone automatically.

If you notice the AirPlay icon on the upper-left corner when you open your video app, the AirPlay device is selected and will stream the video on your TV once you hit play.

To use AirPlay on a different device, tap the AirPlay icon, then select another device. Alternatively, tap it to stop streaming via AirPlay.

Wrapping up…

Mirroring your iPhone screen to Android TV is pretty hassle-free. And the fun of a bigger display, whether you are gaming, surfing or watching shows, is pretty great as well. Please feel free to ping us in the comment section, in case of any query.

Read more:

  • Best screen mirroring apps for iPhone and iPad

excerpt.rendered: Android TV has no native AirPlay, but several apps bridge the gap. Here are four ways to mirror an iPhone screen, plus what to do when video jumps to an AirPlay device unprompted.

title.rendered: How to delete macOS Sonoma’s live wallpapers

content.rendered:
Truth be told, macOS Sonoma’s live wallpapers are nothing short of gorgeous. These stunning screensavers show slow-motion videos of places worldwide — including underwater. It’s pretty hard not to get hooked and download a bunch just to see how they look. But here’s the catch: these videos take up much disk space once downloaded. If you’re trying to figure out how to delete those previously downloaded live wallpapers from your Mac running on macOS Sonoma, here’s all the information you need.

  • Where to find live wallpapers on Mac?
  • Where are macOS Sonoma wallpapers stored?
  • How to permanently delete macOS Sonoma wallpapers
  • How to reset Wallpaper services on Mac

Where to find live wallpapers on Mac?

  1. To choose and set the wallpaper for your Mac, including macOS Sonoma’s live wallpapers, you need to go to the Apple menu → System Settings → Wallpapers. 

  2. macOS Sonoma’s live wallpapers are found below Dynamic Wallpapers and are grouped under categories like Landscape, Cityscape, Underwater, and Earth.

Unlike in the previous macOS versions, where all wallpapers are built-in, you’ll need to download the live wallpaper you want before you can use it as a display for your desktop.

Where are macOS Sonoma wallpapers stored?

Once you’ve downloaded the macOS Sonoma wallpapers, Mac stores them on your Startup Disk.

  1. To be specific, you can open Finder.
  2. Go to the menu bar, select Go → Go to Folder or press Shift + Cmd + G on your keyboard.
  3. Then enter this destination:  /Library/Application Support/com.apple.idleassetsd/Customer/

You’ll see different folders with different formats and resolutions, but all your downloaded videos are likely stored in a single folder, probably depending on your screen resolution.

How to permanently delete macOS Sonoma wallpapers

Since these folders aren’t system-protected, you can easily delete them.

  1. As mentioned above, open Finder → From the menu bar, select Go → Go to Folder. Then enter the destination: /Library/Application Support/com.apple.idleassetsd/Customer/

  2. Just delete all the folders if you want to get rid of all the macOS Sonoma live wallpapers.
    • Before removing any downloaded wallpapers from your system, it would be a good idea to quit System Settings first. 
  3. If you only want to delete the previously downloaded live wallpapers you have no plans on using, just open the folder, select the file, and press Cmd + Delete on your keyboard.
    • You can also drag each folder to the Trash on your Mac’s Dock.  

How to reset Wallpaper services on Mac

After deleting wallpapers on your Mac, reset Wallpaper services to ensure the changes take effect. This will refresh the System Settings interface. To do this:

  1. Close System Settings.
  2. Launch Finder.

  3. In the menu bar, pick Go → Utilities → Activity Monitor.

  4. Select Wallpaper in the Activity Monitor. A popup will appear. Select Quit to confirm your decision.



    • Doing so stops Wallpaper service. Your macOS will automatically restart the Wallpaper service and restore your wallpaper to its default if you deleted the one you’re currently using before deleting the live wallpaper.
  5. Then, select Wallpaper (System Settings). This stops the service responsible for System Settings’ Wallpaper UI and automatically restarts it.

Now, when you head back to the Wallpapers section in your System Settings, it will correctly show which wallpapers are still downloaded and which have been removed.

Why should you consider resetting wallpaper services on Mac?

After you’ve removed the live wallpapers, you might notice a bit of a lag in the update within the System Settings. Even though you’ve already removed the downloaded wallpapers from your Mac, they might still appear as if they’re downloaded in the Wallpapers section of your System Settings.

To make sure your Mac reflects the changes after deleting wallpapers, you’ll need to reset the Wallpaper services. This step is crucial because it refreshes the user interface of the Wallpaper section in your System Settings.

Wrapping up…

While macOS Sonoma live wallpapers look really stunning and eye-catching, downloading these wallpapers might hurt your disk space. Ideally, keep only the ones you plan to choose and delete the rest. Don’t worry — you can always download them again.

Did it work for you? Let us know in the comments section!

Read more:

  • How to remove wallpapers on iPhone
  • 4 Ways to change the wallpaper on Mac to any image

title.rendered: Best karaoke apps for iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Always humming along with some tune or other? Why not make karaoke your claim to fame? If you need some help, here are the best karaoke apps for iPhone and iPad that you can try. What’s more, like DJ apps, these karaoke apps are perfect for livening up casual gatherings and parties. So, wait no more; just scroll down.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Smule – Editor's choice
  • 2. Karaoke – Sing Unlimited Songs
  • 3. Voloco: Vocal Recording Studio
  • 4. Sing Karaoke – Unlimited Songs
  • 5. The Voice – Sing Karaoke
  • 6. Learn to Sing, Singing Lessons
  • 7. KaraFun – Karaoke & Singing

1. Smule – Editor’s choice

Smule produces some of the finest and most innovative music-related software, and this social singing app stands true to that reputation. It is feature-packed with an extensive song library and social sharing options.

Moreover, you can join other members from around the globe to create duets or group songs. It also lets you sing with renowned artists like Ed Sheeran and Luis Fonsi. Make your creations sound even better with the voice enhancement features.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $2.99)

Download

2. Karaoke – Sing Unlimited Songs

This app lets you sing from a limitless catalog of music that you can access for free. Further, you can even record your renditions and share them with friends, family, and the world. There’s also support for multiple languages.

You’ll love the way your voice gets auto-enhanced with echo and a little reverb that makes you sound great each time. You can use special voice effects like chorus, radio, and more for even more finetuning.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $2.99)

Download

3. Voloco: Vocal Recording Studio

Voloco is one of the best iPhone and iPad karaoke apps that offers unique real-time voice processing with features such as automatic tuning, harmony, and vocoding. You can record your performance in audio or video to create a music selfie for social media.

Just pick a track from your personal music collection or Voloco’s free beat library to sing or rap over to get started. The app will guess the key of the song and tune your voice to that key. There are also dozens of presets to enhance your experience.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $2.99)

Download

4. Sing Karaoke – Unlimited Songs 

Sing your heart out and practice your classic favorites with the extensive music library on this app. You can even build playlists for your Karaoke party and record yourself alone or while singing along with your friends.

You can also record and share your video with friends and family. Further, you can download your favorite songs for offline karaoke. An advanced player with an innovative split display makes this one of the best karaoke apps.

Price: Free (Weekly Subscription – $5.99)

Download

5. The Voice – Sing Karaoke

The Voice app is exciting as it allows you to sing along to your favorite songs and share it with your friends. Moreover, you can connect with the app’s community of millions of music lovers.

Not only can you perform solos and upload them, but you can also create duets with singers across the globe as well, So, unleash the vocal artist within you and let the world witness your talent.

Price: Free (In-app Purchases start from $7.99)

Download

6. Learn to Sing, Singing Lessons

If you’re serious about improving your singing skills while crooning along to your favorite tunes, this app is worth checking out. It’s a gasified vocal training program that detects your singing pitch accuracy in real time to help you get better.

You can start with warm-ups and progress through ten levels that will enhance your vocal range. At the same time, you can add studio-style effects and even pictures to your recordings. With over a thousand ear training and vocal control exercises, this is one of the best apps for budding singers.

Price: Free (Remove Ad – $2.99)

Download

7. KaraFun – Karaoke & Singing

Set a singing date with your friends, and have a blast with KaraFun. You can sign up for a free account to get access to a handful of full-length karaoke songs. Then, if you like what you hear, you can subscribe to access the entire catalog of 35,000 tracks.

It boasts several additional features, such as saving songs as favorites and downloading for offline music streaming. Beginners can gain confidence by first singing along with a professional voice. If needed, you can also change the pitch to sing in a lower or higher key.

Price: Free (Pass VIP – $6.99)

Download

Summing Up 

Do you love singing along to your favorite songs? If so, which of these karaoke apps do you think is the best? Share in the comments below.

title.rendered: How to find Apple Card number on iPhone, Mac, or Apple Watch

content.rendered:
You probably noticed when you received your titanium Apple Card that it’s not just pretty but pretty bare as well. You can’t see the card number, expiration date, or security code. While this is a wonderful security feature, what do you do if you need to see your apple card number and other details for a purchase? In this article, we’ll show you how to find your Apple Card number on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, along with other card information.

  • Available Apple Card details
  • How to view Apple Card number on iPhone
  • How to see Apple Card number on iPad
  • How to find your Apple Card number on Mac
  • How to view Apple Card number on Apple Watch

Available Apple Card details

Like other credit cards, Apple Card has a number, expiration date, and security code.

The difference, however, is that the physical titanium card does not display these details, providing you a level of security. So, if you want to make a purchase online or from a retailer that doesn’t accept Apple Pay, you can’t simply grab the card from your pocket and enter the information.

Additionally, Apple Card has both a physical and a virtual number. The physical card number is used when purchasing items in person and “swiping” your card, whereas the virtual card number is used when you make an online purchase.

For security reasons, you can only see the last four digits of the physical card number on your Apple device. This may be necessary if you’re returning an item purchased with your Apple Card. But you can obtain the full virtual card number for the times when you need it for a purchase.

Follow along below to learn how to view the Apple Card number, expiration date, and CVV on your Apple devices.

How to view Apple Card number on iPhone

To see both the virtual card number and the last four digits of the physical Apple Card number on your iPhone along with other details, follow these steps.

  1. Open the Wallet app on your iPhone → Select your Apple Card.
  2. Tap the card number icon (credit card with 123) on the top right.
    • Use your passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID when prompted.
  3. Beside Card Number, you’ll see the virtual card number. 
  4. Select Additional Card Numbers to see the last four digits of the physical card number. 
  5. Tap the arrow on the top left and Done to exit when you finish.

How to see Apple Card number on iPad

Because iPad doesn’t yet provide a Wallet app, you’ll need to visit the Settings app to obtain your Apple Card number and other details.

  1. Open Settings → Select Wallet & Apple Pay on the left.
  2. Choose your Apple Card on the right.

  3. Tap Card Information. 
    Use your passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID when prompted.

  4. Below Virtual Card Number, you’ll see all of the card details.
  5. Select Additional Card Numbers to see the last four digits of the physical card number.

  6. Tap the arrow on the top left when you finish.

How to find your Apple Card number on Mac

While you can get the full virtual card number and other details for Apple Card on your mobile devices and wearable, this isn’t available on macOS. You can, however, get the last four digits of the number which is handy if you’re dealing with a return or refund.

  1. Open your System Settings using the icon in your Dock or Apple icon in the menu bar.
  2. Select Wallet & Apple Pay on the left.

  3. Choose your Apple Card on the right.
  4. Click Show next to Card Numbers to view the last four digits.

  5. When you finish, select Hide to hide the numbers and Done at the bottom to close the Apple Card detail screen.

How to view Apple Card number on Apple Watch

Another handy way to obtain your Apple Card number and other information is using your Apple Watch.

  1. Open the Wallet app → Select your Apple Card.
  2. Scroll down a bit and tap Card Details.
  3. Enter your passcode when prompted.
  4. You’ll then see the card number, expiration date, and security code. Move to the bottom of the screen to view the last four digits of the device account number.
  5. Tap the arrow on the top left to exit. 

Attractive and secure

The eye-catching titanium Apple Card is not only attractive but provides extra security by eliminating the card number and other details from its appearance. And by adding the card to Apple Pay, you rarely have to take it out of your physical wallet. However, if you want to pay for merchandise with an online retailer that doesn’t accept Apple Pay, you now know how to get the virtual card number and information to make your purchase.

Read more:

  • What to do if your Apple Card gets lost or stolen?
  • How to fix the “Apple Card cannot be used” error in Wallet app

title.rendered: 20+ Tips to use Apple Notes app on Mac

content.rendered:
The built-in note app on macOS may not have all the fancy features various third-party note-taking apps offer. But it’s straightforward and user-friendly, providing what you need to take notes like a champ. In this article, I’ll share some handy tips for using the Apple Notes app on your Mac like a pro!

1. Organize notes into folders on Mac

Managing your daily to-dos is tough, but sorting out those in your Mac’s Notes app can make things easier. I’ve got some simple steps to help you tidy up your notes by putting them into folders on your Mac.

  1. Open the Notes app.
  2. Click the Sidebar button at the top.
  3. Select iCloud or On My Mac.

  4. Click the New Folder button.
    You can also convert it into a Smart Folder.
  5. Enter a name for the folder.
  6. Click OK.

  7. Drag the notes you want to organize into the folder.

2. Use bullet points and numbered lists

Bullet points are handy for keeping your notes tidy. They can also help you structure your notes, whether listing steps for a task or arranging the order of things you need to do.

  1. Write down your notes.
  2. Select the notes you want as bullets.
  3. Click the formatting button (Aa icon).
  4. Choose one of the following:
    • Bulleted List
    • Dashed List
    • Numbered List

3. Add headings to structure notes on Mac

Adding headings to your notes is like giving your notes a little road map.

  1. Select the text you want to turn into a heading.
  2. Click the format button (Aa icon).
  3. Choose Title, Heading, or Subheading.


    Trust me, it’ll make finding stuff in your notes a breeze. There is no need for fancy terms here; just click and type your way to organized note nirvana!

4. Format text in Mac Notes app

Formatting text is crucial for distinguishing headings, paragraphs, bullet points, and other elements. Apple gets this and offers a way to format your text as you like it. However, you can use paragraph styles only in upgraded iCloud notes or notes stored on your Mac.

Change formatting

  1. Select the text you want to format.
  2. Choose the formatting option (Aa icon).

  3. Select from the below-mentioned:
    • Bold
    • Italics
    • Underline
    • Strikethrough

Modify text font, color, size, and more

  1. Select the text you want to change.
  2. Right-click the selection.
  3. Choose Font → Select Show Colors.

    Now, perform any font style customization you prefer.

Change the default title paragraph style

  1. Go to the Notes menu.
  2. Select Settings.

  3. Click the New notes start with the menu.
  4. Choose your preferred default paragraph style from the options available.

Add block quotes

You can use the block quote feature in Apple Notes when adding a citation to your note. Also, you may use the Monostyle format to add a grey background to the paragraph. For that,

  1. Select the text you want to highlight in Notes.
  2. Right-click the text → Select Paragraph Styles.
  3. Choose Monospaced.

    Besides, you can get formatting options from the Format option on the menu bar.

5. Highlight important information with colors

When utilizing the Apple Notes app on your Mac, one valuable tip to enhance your organization and productivity is highlighting important information with colors. This feature allows you to visually categorize and prioritize your notes, making locating crucial details at a glance easier.

Whether you’re flagging essential to-do items in a checklist, emphasizing key points in a meeting summary, or distinguishing between personal and work-related notes, the ability to apply colors adds an extra layer of organization and clarity to your digital workspace.

  1. Select the text you want to highlight.
  2. Right-click on the text → Select Font → Choose Show Colors.
  3. Pick a color of your choice.

6. Pin important notes

Like sticking a note on your fridge, you can pin important notes at the top. This way, you won’t have to scroll or search for your essential grocery list or the inspiring quote that motivates you.

  1. Select the note you want to keep at the top.
  2. Right-click on the note.
  3. Choose Pin Note.

7. Share notes with others and tag them for collaboration

Sharing your notes with others for excellent collaborative editing is one of my favorite features of the Apple Notes app. It’s like a virtual team huddle for your notes. No more endless email chains or confusing versions of your notes. It’s all right there in one place.

Also, while editing, you can tag any recipients on the Note. So they can know which area you want them to focus on. So, go ahead, share the knowledge, and make your notes better together.

8. Create Quick Notes

Quick Notes is a convenient tool for capturing your ideas on the fly or quickly jotting down important information without opening the Notes app. This feature is perfect for swiftly recording brief thoughts, saving web content, noting phone numbers, and more.

9. Copy-and-paste styles

One valuable tip when using the Apple Notes app on your Mac is to make the most of the copy-and-paste styles feature. This feature allows you to effortlessly maintain consistency and formatting throughout your notes.

  1. Select the text you want to copy style from.
  2. Right-click and choose Copy Style.
  3. Now, highlight the text you want to format.
  4. Right-click on the text → Select Paste Style.

10. Use Checklist feature for task management in Notes app

Remember the handy Checklist feature when managing your tasks with the Apple Notes app on your Mac. It’s like your digital to-do list buddy you need when doing work, school assignments, or making sure you complete a set of tasks.

  1. Choose the text you want to turn into a checklist.
  2. Click the checklist icon.

    And there you have it! You’ve got yourself a checklist right there in your note. Now, you can simply click the check box next to your completed tasks. The cool part is that it automatically sorts the list.

11. Attach files and images to Notes

Don’t forget the magic of attaching files and images when jazzing up your Apple Notes game on your trusty Mac. It’s like giving your notes a superpower! To attach a photo to your Apple Notes, simply.

  1. Click the image icon in the menu bar.

  2. Choose one of the following options:
    • Photos
    • Take Photo
    • Scan Documents
    • Add Sketch

Alternatively, you can drag and drop images or files onto the note to which you want to add them.

12. Create links and add them to other notes

Apple Notes keeps getting better with each macOS update. In the latest iteration of macOS, the makers added a feature many folks have been asking for: the ability to link related notes together. Now, you can hop between different notes, even if they’re tucked away in separate folders within the Notes app. Check out our handy guide to learn how to link notes with one another in iOS 17 and macOS Sonoma.

13. Use tags to categorize and find notes easily on Mac

Tags make it easy to sort and tidy up your notes on your Mac. Using tags in the new Notes app is a breeze. When making a note, just put a hashtag symbol (#) followed by the word you want to use as a tag. For example, #newtag. It’ll turn yellow, which means your tag is good to go.

Next, head over to the folders section and scroll down to find your tags (Apple calls this the Tag Browser, fancy, right?). Then, just tap on a tag to see all the notes with that tag. You can also tap multiple tags to see notes with all those tags simultaneously.

14. Use search function

Sometimes, you might have many notes and can’t find a specific one because you forget where to put them. Don’t worry, though! The Notes app has a handy search feature that can save the day. Here’s what you do.

  1. Open the Notes app.
  2. Click the magnifying glass icon in the top right corner.
  3. Type in the name of your note or some words from it.
  4. You’ll see a list of all the notes that match your search.
  5. Choose the one you want to open.

15. Lock sensitive notes on Mac

You can’t lock apps on a Mac by default without needing a third-party app. However, Apple offers a convenient feature for securing your Notes with a password or Touch ID, providing added protection and simplifying the process on your Mac.

Go through our detailed guide to lock Notes on your Mac.

16. Create notes with Siri

One handy tip to optimize your use of the Apple Notes app on your Mac is to harness the power of Siri to create notes effortlessly with voice commands. Siri is Apple’s virtual assistant that seamlessly integrates with the Notes app, making it a breeze to jot down thoughts, reminders, or ideas.

  1. Simply activate Siri by saying, “Hey Siri,” or clicking the Siri icon in your menu bar.
  2. Instruct it to Create a new note or Add a note to my [specific folder] in Notes.
  3. Siri will promptly open the Notes app and transcribe your spoken words into a new note.

You can do more with Siri on your Mac. If you’re curious about all the cool stuff Siri can do with the Notes app, feel free to comment below, and I’ll spill the beans.

17. Use tables for structured data

Tables are like the unsung heroes of the organization. They play a crucial role in maintaining order and organization, whether you’re documenting your monthly expenditures, monitoring your fitness routines, or coordinating a communal meal. To create a table,

  1. Head to a note → Select the text you want to place in the table.
  2. Click the table icon in the Notes menu.

18. Change default account for new notes on Mac

Imagine having various accounts configured, such as iCloud and Gmail, and the desire to ensure that your notes are directed to the correct destination. Here’s the scoop on changing the default account for new notes in Apple Notes on your Mac.

  1. Head to your Notes app.
  2. Click on Notes in the menu bar → Select Accounts.

  3. Choose Add Account → Follow the on-screen instructions.

19. Create keyboard shortcuts

If you’re tired of clicking a lot to do simple things on your Mac’s Note app, there’s a way to make it easier. You can use simple Keyboard shortcuts to do things faster. You can even make key combinations for things you do a lot.

  1. Click the Apple logo () → Pick System Settings.
  2. Head to Keyboard → Select Keyboard Shortcuts.

  3. Choose Keyboard → Change the actions with your favorite combination.

20. Export notes as PDF or text files

Whether you need to send a detailed report, share meeting minutes, or simply want to create a backup of your notes, the export feature simplifies the process. You can do so by exporting your Notes as a PDF.

  1. Launch the Notes app.
  2. Click the Files option in the menu bar → Select Export as PDF.

  3. Type the name of the file → Choose a location to save the file.
  4. Finally, click the Save button.

Also, you can open and go through PDFs in the Notes app on macOS Sonoma.

21. Set reminders for notes on Mac

Remember to use reminders for your notes with deadlines. It’s similar to having a virtual sticky note that reminds you when it’s time to do something.

22. Backup notes to iCloud or a local storage

Backing up your Notes app on a Mac keeps you from worrying when something unexpected happens. It makes your valuable information remain safe and sound. You have two main options: iCloud or keeping them on your Mac.

If you go with iCloud, your notes are securely stored in the cloud, and you can access them easily from all your Apple devices. On the other hand, if you opt for local storage, your notes stay right on your Mac’s hard drive. You’re in control; your data doesn’t leave your computer.

Can I synchronize my notes across all my Apple devices?

Yes, you can seamlessly sync your notes across your Mac, iPhone, iPad, and other Apple devices. This can be achieved by activating iCloud sync within the Notes settings.

Can I access my notes without an internet connection?

If you’ve enabled iCloud sync, your notes will remain accessible on your Mac, even offline and not connected to the internet.

How do I get back notes that I accidentally deleted?

You can quickly recover your deleted notes on your Mac if they are not permanently deleted from iCloud.

Use notes on Mac like a pro!

I hope these Apple Notes tips for your Mac have been super helpful in leveling up your note-taking game. Do you have any more cool tricks up your sleeve that you’d like to add to this list?

Don’t hesitate to drop them in the comments section!

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Best Trivia Games for iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Trivia quiz games and apps are a fun way to spend quality time with friends and family. Apart from everyday amusement, these quiz apps also test your general knowledge. Now, control your family’s hilarious nerve center by playing the best trivia games for iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Trivia Crack
  • 2. Jeopardy! World Tour
  • 3. SongPop 2: Guess The Song
  • 4. Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
  • 5. Psych! Outwit Your Friends
  • 6. Stupid Test!
  • 7. TRIVIA 360: Quiz Game
  • 8. Trivia to Go – the Quiz Game
    • Signing off…

1. Trivia Crack

This is one of the most renowned boredom killers in the world. Packed with thousands of questions, this app tests your knowledge in six categories. Science, Geography, Sports, Entertainment, Art, and History.

A spinner wheel (Willy) selects a question for you. Alternatively, you can create your own questions in Factory. The game is available in 20 different languages. You can chat with your adversaries while playing an online trivia game with friends.

Price: Free (In-app Purchase starts at $0.99)
Download

2. Jeopardy! World Tour

Originally started in the 1960s, this TV game show is now available on a digital screen of your iOS device. You can play this game anywhere – whether at home or on travel.

Play this game with your friends and earn free Power-Ups. This game offers thousands of clues and categories. You can challenge your friends, who could be sitting miles away.

The free version of this app shows you ads; you can remove ads with in-app purchases.

Price: Free (In-app Purchase starts at $1.99)
Download

3. SongPop 2: Guess The Song

A killer combination of music and games, SongPop 2 is the largest music trivia community. Once you are the part, you can listen to actual songs. Next, you need to guess the song as quickly as possible.

The app features all the music greats like Taylor Swift, Selena Gomez, Drake, Justin Bieber, and others. You can challenge your friends or colleagues and play in front of all the music lovers.

SongPop 2 keeps its playlists dynamic. Every day, they add new music and playlists.

Price: Free (In-app Purchase starts at $0.99)
Download

4. Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

Slotted in the top ten trivia games for iPhone and iPad, this is a digital version of a popular TV show. Mimicking the TV format, this game allows you to take the help of the audience. You can also seek advice from a team of experts you have built.

Apart from the above life-lines, this iOS game also retains the classic 50:50. As you succeed in this game, you can unlock more cities and travel across the world. In each city, you can build a team of experts.

Price: Free (In-app Purchase starts at $1.99)
Download

5. Psych! Outwit Your Friends

Here is your party game to play with friends and colleagues. Psych allows you to select any fun category from a variety. A challenging part of this game is selecting real answers from fakes given by friends.

If you guess the right answer, you will get points. Moreover, you can also claim points when you psych your friends into selecting your answers.

The best iPhone trivia game for road trips, camping, or any other outdoor activity.

Price: Free (In-app Purchase starts at $0.99)
Download

6. Stupid Test!

If you’re a trivia fan, you’ve got to check out this fun interactive game that will test how ‘stupid’ you are. Yes, that’s right, the catch is to pay close attention to the wording to prevent going wrong with your answers.

Over 800 questions will keep you addicted, and game center integration means you can challenge your friends and family. The user-friendly interface and beautiful graphics further add to the experience.

Price: Free
Download

7. TRIVIA 360: Quiz Game

Trivia 360 is free to play anytime, anywhere. You are not supposed to make any in-app purchases to enjoy unlimited trivia. You can join millions of users across the world to play a free quiz game on iPhone or iPad.

Although it seems easy to play, it is a brain game in excellent ways. An addictive game gives your IQ a remarkable boost. Furthermore, you will enjoy true-false questions in addition to the classic multiple-choice questions.

You can set limits for 60, 90, or 120 seconds. Learn new stuff and have fun! The game is available in 12 different languages.

Price: Free
Download

8. Trivia to Go – the Quiz Game

Here’s another awesome trivia game that’s designed for iPad with dramatic graphics and quick rounds that keep things interesting. In each round, you’re challenged to ten questions, and the difficulty level gradually increases depending on your skills.

The questions are both challenging and entertaining. Plus, they cover a diverse range of topics, from science and history to film, art, and more. Brush up on your trivia skills and impress everyone around you.

Price: Free ($0.99 for Monthly Premium)
Download

That’s all!

Signing off…

Etermax seems to be ruling this space of trivia games and apps. The developers have designed awesome content for your weekend get-together. Which trivia game do you like the most? Share your feedback with us in the Comments section below.

title.rendered: How to use AirTag: Ultimate guide to track your items

content.rendered:
Apple AirTags are Bluetooth trackers that can be attached to your keys, wallet, backpack, or other belongings. The tags use the Find My network to help you track down your lost items. In this guide, I will provide a comprehensive explanation of what AirTags are and demonstrate how you can set up and use the same.

How to set up AirTag

The best part about an AirTag is that it takes care of things independently. There isn’t much you have to do to get started. However, before we begin, ensure you meet the following requirements to activate an AirTag without hassle.

  • iPhone, iPad, or iPod running on iOS 14.5 or iPadOS 14.5 or later
  • Turn on two-factor authentication
  • Enable Find My and Bluetooth
  • A strong cellular or Wi-Fi connection
  • Turn on Location Services

There are multiple methods to activate your AirTag. Let’s discuss them!

Method 1: Via Home Page

  1. For new AirTags, remove the wraparound and pull out the tab to activate the battery.
  2. Wait till you hear a beep.
    It signifies that AirTag is activated.
  3. Close the lid by rotating it in a clockwise direction.
  4. Now, hold the AirTag close to your device and wait for the AirTag setup animation to appear on your home screen.
  5. Tap Connect → Choose a name and emoji for your AirTag.
  6. Hit Agree to link the AirTag with your Apple ID.

  7. Wait till the AirTag is paired to your device.
  8. Tap Done to conclude the process.

Method 2: Via Find My

  1. Follow the steps 1-4 discussed above.
  2. Launch Find My on your iPhone or iPad.
  3. Navigate to Items → Tap Add Item.
  4. Hit Add AirTag → Connect to get started.

  5. Wait till the AirTag is paired successfully.
  6. Once connected, name the AirTag as you desire.
    Here, you can choose from preset titles or create one.
  7. If you curate a custom name, select an emoji.
  8. Hit Continue → Use This iPhone.
  9. Now, select Agree to pair the AirTag to your Apple ID.

  10. Once paired, tap Done.

Note: If you’ve multiple AirTags nearby, ensure only the one you wish to set up is in the range of your iPhone, or it may cause interference later.

How to use AirTag

After successfully pairing your AirTag to your device, let’s explore how you can assign tasks. Regardless of how you’ve connected AirTag to your device, you can find them all listed in the Find My app.

  1. Access Find My app on your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Go to the Items menu → Select your AirTag.
  3. Now, you will see the live location indicating where the AirTag is located.
  4. Swipe up the bottom menu for controls.

  5. Here, you can take on a series of actions like:

Play Sound

By tapping this option, your AirTag will play a chime. The sound emitted from the AirTag is loud enough to be heard even from a considerable distance. So you can quickly locate misplaced or lost items.

Note that playing a sound through an AirTag may require Bluetooth connectivity between the iPhone or iPad and the AirTag device. Thus, ensuring proper proximity between both devices enhances performance efficiency.

Track AirTag on iPhone

After you turn on AirTags, you can use the Find feature to quickly pinpoint their item’s specific location. This feature facilitates proximity tracking by providing detailed visual cues, live navigation updates, Tracking Notifications, and haptic feedback on your iPhone.

  1. Tap the Find option.
  2. Follow the on-screen direction arrow to know the AirTag location.
  3. Once found, tap the close icon to exit the menu.

Share AirTag

For those who wish to add multiple participants to their AirTag can simply:

  1. Tap Add Person in the Share This AirTag menu.
  2. Hit Continue.
  3. Select a saved contact or manually enter their details and tap the (+) icon.
  4. Once added, choose Share.

  5. Wait for a few seconds until the chosen user ID is paired.
  6. Now, the added individual must accept your request to access the Airtag.

Lost Mode

If you cannot locate your AirTag, mark it as lost in the Find My app. This will allow other iPhone users to view a message with your contact information when they come across your AirTag. To do so,

  1. Tap Enable under Lost Mode.
  2. Hit Continue when prompted.

  3. Enter your Email Address or Phone Number.
  4. Hit Next → Activate to conclude the process.

Doing so will alert every Apple user within the range of your AirTag with a lost tag. They can either report or contact you directly if found. Moreover, this practice is effective for Android users as well.

Rename Item

Finally, scroll down until you find the Rename section and tap it to rename your item.

  1. Select a new preset item name or compose one custom title.
  2. Tap the cross icon to erase the predefined name and type a new one.
  3. Choose an emoji describing the AirTag.
  4. Once altered, hit Done.

Your renamed item will be reflected across all linked devices associated with your Apple ID, ensuring convenient identification. Choosing a recognizable title that accurately identifies the object to which you have attached the AirTag is advised.

By following these steps above, users can professionally harness the full potential of their AirTags’ features.

How to unpair or reset AirTag

While AirTag offers abundant convenience and safety for one’s belongings, there is a high chance that your purpose of using an AirTag may change. For instance, you may want to pair the same AirTag with a different Apple ID. In such scenarios, resetting the tag seems the most viable option.

  1. Open the Find My app on your iPhone.
  2. Navigate to the Items menu and select the respective AirTag.
  3. Access the control menu → Tap Remove Item.
  4. Select Remove → Remove to unpair the AirTag from your current Apple ID.

On completing this process, the AirTag will unlink the device from the Find My app, but it won’t completely reset itself. If you wish to do that, you can go through our detailed guide on how to restore the AirTag to its factory settings.

How to change battery of AirTag

Although the battery life of AirTag is bound to last for a long time, there’ll come a time to replace it. But fret not, as I have got you covered. Take a look through the steps outlined below.

  1. Simply rotate the back lid of AirTag in an anticlockwise direction.
  2. As the lid pops out, replace the battery of the AirTag.
  3. Press the battery until you hear a beep.
  4. Close the lid promptly, and your AirTag is as good as new.

Benefits of using AirTag

Now that I’ve filled your brain bucket with the necessary knowledge to enable and use AirTag on your iPhone and iPad let me enlighten you with possible use cases.

1. The basic stuff

The AirTag boasts many benefits, making it an invaluable tool in everyday life. For instance, its compact design allows for easy attachments to personal belongings such as keys, wallets, or bags. So they are never misplaced or lost again.

With the Find My app on iPhone and iPad, users can effortlessly track the location of their items and receive real-time notifications. Moreover, if you cannot locate the item visually, simply perform the Play Sound action to get an idea of its location. This feature is ideal for individuals with limited mobility or visual impairments.

2. Add a pet collar

One of the primary benefits of using an AirTag on a pet collar is the added security and peace of mind it provides to pet parents. With the ability to track your furry companion’s location in real-time through your iPhone, you can quickly locate them if they wander off or get lost.

This feature is particularly invaluable for those who live in urban areas or have dogs and cats who tend to run away. Furthermore, this device is enriched with durable construction and water resistance, ensuring it withstands daily wear and tear and unexpected weather conditions.

3. Vehicle marker

With the tracking capabilities of the AirTag, users can locate their vehicles in real-time, enabling efficient fleet management.

Additionally, its precise operations ensure accurate geolocation information, even in challenging environments. So, professionals can keep track of their vehicles’ movements and monitor usage patterns.

4. Tracking children

Finally, using an AirTag for tracking children offers several significant benefits. Firstly, it provides peace of mind for parents or guardians by enabling them to always keep a close eye on their child’s whereabouts. This can be particularly valuable in crowded public places, where a child’s separation risk is higher.

Chain your belongings to your device!

And there you have it, your ultimate guide to harnessing the power of AirTags. With these straightforward steps, the stress of lost keys and misplaced items is a thing of the past. Whether it’s your keys, wallet, or anything else you hold dear, AirTags is here to make your life simpler and more organized.

Thank you for reading. Please take a moment to leave your thoughts in the comment section below.

FAQs

Q. Does AirTags use Bluetooth?

Yes, AirTags uses Bluetooth technology to connect to nearby Apple devices.

Q. How far do AirTags work?

Bluetooth connectivity range can vary depending on the environment and other factors, but Apple states that AirTags have a range of up to 800 feet in an open outdoor area.

title.rendered: How to view and change file extensions on iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
Want to use a file in a specific app on your iPhone, but the format is not supported? Worry not! Using the built-in Files app on your iPhone, you can quickly view the file extension and save them in a different format. In this blog post, I’ll share how to view and change file extensions on your iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • Why do you need to change a file extension?
  • How to view files extension in Files app on iPhone
    • Set the Files app to show extensions on all files
  • How to change files extension in Files app on iPhone and iPad
  • How to fix files not opening after changing extension on iPhone

Why do you need to change a file extension?

  • When transferring files between multiple devices, extensions may mess up, making the file unreadable on your iPhone. If you haven’t backed up the file, you can lose it permanently. Changing the extension to the right type can retrieve the file.
  • Make a file work with a specific app.
  • You may save a file with a different extension for security reasons. Once, I changed a sensitive PDF file’s extension to JPG. So, whenever anyone opened it, my iPhone displayed an error. However, I can open that file by simply changing the extension to PDF.

How to view files extension in Files app on iPhone

Most extensions, like .jpg, .png, .pdf, etc., are hidden in the Files app. So, before changing the extension, you must verify its existing type.

  1. Launch the Files app → Select the folder.
  2. Tap and hold your desired file → Tap Get Info.
  3. Check the file name’s suffix or the file type next to Kind under Information.
  4. Tap Done.

Set the Files app to show extensions on all files

  1. Open the folder in the Files app.
  2. Tap the three dots → View Options.

  3. Select Show All Extensions.
  4. Now, all file names will appear with extensions.

How to change files extension in Files app on iPhone and iPad

Extensions play a vital role as the iPhone could only open the file with the app suggested by the extension. So, be careful while performing the steps. Also, you must turn on the Show All Extension feature beforehand.

  1. Open the Files app → Locate the file whose extension you want to change.
  2. Tap and hold the file → Select Rename.
  3. Select the extension and remove it.
  4. Now, type your desired extension.
  5. Tap Done → Select Use [.extension name].

That’s all! You have successfully changed the file extension for a file using the Files app on your iPhone. Check if the new file is opening correctly before sharing. It can help prevent compatibility issues and ensure the intended recipient correctly recognizes the file.

How to fix files not opening after changing extension on iPhone

After altering its extension, a file may not open for the following reasons:

  • Your extension was incorrect, like using an audio extension for a document file.
  • You mistyped the extension name.
  • iOS does not support that file format.
  • The file is broken.

Try to rename the file again or download the file afresh and change its extension. If nothing seems to work, you may use an online file converter.

Get your desired file type!

Viewing and changing extensions for a file using the Files app on your iPhone or iPad is incredibly useful to ensure that everything is saved in the correct format. Also, it gives you more control over your files and makes it easier to work with them on the go. If you face any issues with the steps, please let me know in the comments!

FAQs

Can I open any unsupported file by changing its extension on iPhone or iPad?

No. The files in different formats are encoded a certain way, and simply changing their extension doesn’t convert the file data. I tried an MKV movie on my iPhone by changing its extension from .mkv to .mp4. But it didn’t work because Photos, Files, or QuickTime Player doesn’t natively support MKV. If the file was originally in MP4 and accidentally changed to MKV, renaming it would help. 

Explore more…

  • How to use Files app on iPhone or iPad like a pro
  • How to play MKV files on iPhone without converting
  • How to find size of files and photos on iPhone and iPad

mainEntity.name: Q. Does AirTags use Bluetooth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AirTags uses Bluetooth technology to connect to nearby Apple devices.

mainEntity.name: Q. How far do AirTags work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bluetooth connectivity range can vary depending on the environment and other factors, but Apple states that AirTags have a range of up to 800 feet in an open outdoor area.

mainEntity.name: Can I open any unsupported file by changing its extension on iPhone or iPad?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The files in different formats are encoded a certain way, and simply changing their extension doesn't convert the file data. I tried an MKV movie on my iPhone by changing its extension from .mkv to .mp4. But it didn't work because Photos, Files, or QuickTime Player doesn't natively support MKV. If the file was originally in MP4 and accidentally changed to MKV, renaming it would help.

title.rendered: 4 Ways to close apps on your Mac

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways

  • The easiest way to close apps on Mac is simply by clicking the app’s name in the menu bar, then select “Quit [App Name]” or Press Command (⌘) + Q to quickly close the active app.
  • Force quit unresponsive apps on Mac: Press Command (⌘) + Option (⌥) + Esc to open the Force Quit window. Select the app and click “Force Quit”. or Click the Apple logo in the top left corner, then choose “Force Quit”. Select the app(s) and click “Force Quit”.

If you are somewhat like me, you must be using several tabs and apps on your Mac at once. However, this can produce a cluttered system environment, making it challenging to modify the app in accordance with its requirements.

So, in this article, I will guide you on how to close all apps on Mac.

How to close an app on Mac

If you’re managing multiple apps at once and have to create the system litter-free, it’s wise to minimize or kill a particular app once its purpose is served.

1. Using Close button

The simplest way is to hit the close (X) button on the app’s status bar.

Apart from that, there are three other methods that you can employ, and I have listed them below:

2. Close app using cmd + Q

The quickest way to close a particular Mac app is using the keyboard shortcut cmd (⌘) + Q. This combination will instantly kill the app without hassle.   

However, if you just want to minimize the app, you may use this shortcut: option (⌥)+ cmd (⌘) + W.

This practice will reduce the impact of the app on the battery, and your Mac will significantly last longer.   

3. Quit app from menu bar

  1. Make sure the app is your prime interface.   
  2. Select the name of the application on the menu bar.   
  3. Click Quit [app name].


    This process will close the app.  

4. Close app from dock 

On a Mac, another simple way to close an application is by using the dock bar.

If you have the application’s icon in the Dock, you can right-click on the app icon → select Quit. 

How to force quit app that is not responding on Mac

Closing all open apps and tabs on a Mac is a simple task that can be done in multiple ways. Here are the most commonly used methods to close all apps altogether without needing to close every app individually.

1. Using keyboard shortcuts

  1. Use cmd + option (alt) + esc to invoke the Force Quit Applications dialog box.
  2. Then use cmd (⌘)+ A to select all apps → hit return to kill all open apps at once.
  3. Select Force Quit when prompted to close all apps.

This is the most direct approach to getting the desired outcome within three clicks.

From Mac menu bar

  1. Click the Apple logo () in the top-left corner.
  2. Select Force Quit.
  3. Select all active applications using cmd (⌘) + A → click Force Quit.

  4. Tap Force Quit again to confirm your choice.

Here, you can either close one application or all applications altogether. 

Force quit from App Switcher  

Using the app switcher, you can’t close all apps at once. However, there is a possibility to close each app one by one.

  1. Hold down the cmd (⌘) and press the tab key to open the App Switcher.
    Do not lift your finger from the cmd key.
  2. Now, use tab key to navigate to the app you want to close.
  3. Then hit Q to close that app.
    Further, you may continue hitting Q to quit all apps.

The switcher allows great flexibility over closing the apps. It enables you to have a brief look and make a decision accordingly.

What is the meaning of closing the background apps?

Closing background apps signifies the idea of closing all apps that are not being used. This results in higher and more sustainable battery life for Mac.   

How to close background apps on Mac?  

Tap option + cmd (⌘) + H after making sure the app you need to utilize is accessible. This will result in the simultaneous shutdown of all background programs. 

Does shutting down Mac close all apps?  

Shutting down your Mac without closing the apps is just like turning over the lid on a can. Once you restart your Mac, you’ll be prompted with the same applications you left opened previously.   

Final words… 

The process of closing all open windows or tabs on Mac is not that hard if you know how to do it. Furthermore, when the app crashes or is stuck, you can use the above-mentioned methods to close them. So, I suggest learning these simple solutions to solve frivolous problems like this.   

I hope this article was of great use to you. If you want me to cover more such solutions, do let me know in the comments.

He has reported on smartphones, laptops, and artificial intelligence and tracked tech industry layoffs during this time. His work has been published in prestigious publications such as the Financial Express, Android Headlines, SlashGear, and The Mac Observer."  About Abhinav Anand  Abhinav is a regular contributor to iGeeksBlog, where he writes how-to guides, explainers, and features.  He primarily uses a MacBook Pro and an iPhone 13 for his daily tasks. Besides, he relies on a 9th Gen iPad when he’s away from his desk and has a few Android phones.  Abhinav's love for technology began with reading smartphone reviews for fun. In 2021, he turned his hobby into a career in tech journalism. Now, he's the go-to person for "Which phone/laptop should I buy under X price tag?  Experience   Abhinav Anand has contributed to several major publications, including The Mac Observer, ExtremeTech, SlashGear, KnowTechie, Android Headlines, Financial Express, and Economic Times. He holds a B.A. in Journalism and Mass Communication from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. He specializes in consumer technology, covering smartphones, Apple products, and PC components.
